attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts: RC Scripts (T1037.004)
attackers_goals: Adversaries may establish persistence by modifying RC scripts, which are executed during a Unix-like system's startup.
description: A suspicious process modified an RC script file. These files allow system administrators to map and start custom services at startup for different run levels. This may be done to establish persistence.
investigative_actions: Check the modified RC script file and try to understand the impact of the file modification.
name: Suspicious process modified RC script file
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
